title: All-Hands Orchestra: Playbook and Scenario Scripts (v0.1)
content:
Purpose: prep a pragmatic, low-friction all-hands that surfaces exec priorities, celebrates wins, and leaves teams with 3 concrete takeaways and 1 action each. This doc is a working playbook: scripts for hosts, contingency lines for execs, quick Q&A bank, and a micro-risk register. Use liberally and annotate with final speaker notes before rehearsal.

Key objectives (draft):
- Align: restate top-3 company priorities for next 90 days (revenue motion for Dedicated, scale for Hosted API, and readiness for Private launch).
- Signal: highlight 2 product changes that materially change developer experience (console streaming telemetry, new batching defaults).
- Motivate: showcase 3 wins (customer case, infra SRE metric improvement, research throughput win) and 2 team stories.
- Action: every audience member leaves with one small task (add one priority to team OKR board).

Run of show (45m total):
- 0:00–0:03  — Welcome & housekeeping (host script below)
- 0:03–0:12  — CEO state & north star (10m) (scripted points + 2 slides)
- 0:12–0:20  — Product highlight: Hosted API & Console updates (8m) (demo fallback plan)
- 0:20–0:28  — Engineering highlight: Serving runtime latency story + SLO progress (8m)
- 0:28–0:34  — Customer spotlight (video clip + one-question Q&A) (6m)
- 0:34–0:40  — Ops & Security quick wins + Private deployment timeline (6m)
- 0:40–0:45  — Closing: 3 takeaways, 1 ask, pulse survey link (5m)

Host script snippets (pick tone: candid / crisp):
- Opening: "Quick logistics — recording is on, use Slack #allhands-questions for typed Qs, we'll surface top ones live. Today is about what matters for the next quarter and how each of you can move the needle."
- Close: "If you do one thing this week: add your top team priority to the OKR board and set a measurable signal. We'll follow up with managers to stitch these into product plans."

Exec contingency lines (if question about reliability spike):
- "We saw an unusual traffic pattern on 11/03; fallback routing engaged and kept tail latency within our emergency SLO. We're currently tracking a small regression in a kernel path; infra has a patch scheduled for rollout tomorrow. See JIRA-OPS-1193 for timeline and rollback plan."

Q&A bank (curated):
- Q: How does the Dedicated reserved capacity offer affect pricing for start-ups? A: Short answer + link to pricing FAQ.
- Q: Timeline for Private on-prem pilot? A: Beta next quarter; shortlist of partners will be announced by execs.
- Q: What are the biggest risks to latency SLAs this quarter? A: GC heuristics on newer kernels and peak burst routing — we have mitigations in staging.

Micro risk register (top 5, ownership):
- Risk: Kernel regression after quantization rollout — Owner: infra-release (Luis O.) — Mitigation: canary + rollback gate (GH-PR-4821).
- Risk: Support load from new console features — Owner: customer-success (Priya M.) — Mitigation: staggered feature flags + enablement doc.
- Risk: Sales enablement lag for Dedicated — Owner: go-to-market (Ethan Z.) — Mitigation: 2-week seller bootcamp.

OKR alignment primer (for exec segment):
- Suggested frame: for each exec bullet show: objective (qualitative), 2–3 measurable key results, risks & current confidence (High/Med/Low). Keep to 1 slide per objective.

Pre-meeting checklist (owners in parens):
- Confirm final slides and vids by 11/24 (Samira)
- Rehearsal with hosts + tech run-through 11/29 (Claire)
- Pulse survey drafted and link tested (People Ops)
- Customer clip permissions cleared (Legal)

Follow-ups & deliverables (post-all-hands):
- Publish minutes and timestamped recording in #allhands-link within 24h.
- Manager bundle: one-pager + suggested team discussion prompts for next weekly (Samira).
- OKR update window opens 48h after event; product leads to capture team-level signals.

Notes to self / open questions (unresolved):
- Do we want a live poll during customer segment or prefer typed questions only? Pros: live energy. Cons: potential derail.
- Should the CEO pre-record the intro if calendar conflict arises? If yes, plan for 2 backup speakers.
- Need headcount to support overflow Qs — do we pull on-call CS for 30m afterwards?

References and links (working):
- Draft slides: confluence link (see linked_artifacts).
- Incident postmortem: internal JIRA-2339 (latency incident).

Action items (assign and close before rehearsal):
- Samira to combine product and infra slides into single deck and drop to shared folder by 11/20.
- Claire to confirm A/V (mic + livestream) and test captions by 11/27.
- Priya to prepare customer t-shirt + talking points and confirm consent by 11/21.

If you edit this doc: add your initials and a short rationale for content changes. This playbook is meant to be executable with two rehearsals and a small production overhead — keep it lean.

-- Samira P.
